extracted.intended_audience: newsroom leaders, journalists, media researchers, and newsroom diversity/accountability advocates
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for producing and presenting studies and in-depth reports about the news industry, including data-driven research, expert interviews, case studies, and inclusion/accountability surveys.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce useful custom studies and in-depth reports
rubrics_metrics.description: We invest time, thought and resources to produce useful custom studies and in-depth reports that address the most pressing issues facing media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should be tailored (custom) or in-depth, require significant investment of time/thought/resources, and directly address high-priority problems facing the media industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data-driven and innovative research
rubrics_metrics.description: We conduct data-driven, innovative studies meant to inform the news industry and the public about various important issues facing journalism and the news business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Studies should be grounded in data, apply innovative approaches or methodologies, and be designed to inform both industry practitioners and the broader public about important issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide collections of insights, resources and intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: We also develop an array of reports that offer a collection of insights, resources and intelligence on specific topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports should synthesize findings into actionable insights, compile relevant resources, and provide intelligence focused on clearly defined topical areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include interviews with industry experts and case studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Those reports often feature interviews with industry experts and case studies of what newsrooms are doing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use qualitative elements—expert interviews and newsroom case studies—to illustrate practice, provide context, and demonstrate real-world applications of findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative research partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: In partnership with The AP-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research, we have formed a joint research initiative called the Media Insight Project to better understand news consumers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage formal partnerships with reputable research organizations to strengthen credibility, expand expertise, and support large-scale or joint research initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and measurability of newsroom demographics
rubrics_metrics.description: The API Media Inclusion & Impact Survey ensures newsroom demographics remain transparent and measurable...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research and surveys about newsroom inclusion should collect and report demographic data in ways that allow transparency and measurement over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide actionable data for more inclusive workplaces
rubrics_metrics.description: ...provides actionable data for more inclusive workplaces...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Findings should be translated into concrete, actionable recommendations or metrics that newsrooms can use to improve inclusion and workplace practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage a culture of accountability in journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: ...and encourages a culture of accountability in journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research outputs should promote practices and reporting that hold organizations accountable, fostering ongoing evaluation and improvement in the industry.
